plan.problem: Saved v8 month97 JSON would bring same-origin localStorage usage to approximately 2,627,469 UTF-16 units; historic WebKit 5MiB / UTF16 limit is approximately 2,621,440 units. The legacy wholesale v20 key alone occupies 769,905 units.
plan.currentContract: Canonical current AmberTime save key is sukimastock.ambertime.main.v1; all keys on sukimastock.github.io share localStorage per browser profile. Save v8 compact codec current. Keep latest session and exported month97 file intact.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: Read-only diagnostics can measure but not safely archive an explicitly selected legacy entry. Chrome iOS lacks convenient safe key-specific export+verification UI.
plan.design: One separate noindex, CSP restricted HTML with exactly fixed legacy key. Download JSON, reimport and compare exact raw text, explicit checkbox and window.confirm, then remove only if unchanged. No fetch, no telemetry, never show raw value on page.
plan.migration: No game migration. Explicit user action archives then optionally removes a legacy key. Month97 restore uses existing debug import reader; external exported session remains original.
plan.compatibility: No current game or legacy reader changes; backup is a separate versioned envelope, not auto-imported as a game session.
plan.promotionRisk: Staging-only one-time user-operated cleanup tool, not production release. Actual user cleanup remains in control of the user.
